entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and you've reached VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Hi, David... I, uh, I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for this.
I'm sorry to hear that you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you tell me a bit more about the item? What specifically is the issue?

It's the new AeroTech jersey. I've been a VeloFit customer for years and always get the same size. But this one... it's just the wrong size. It's way too tight across the chest and I can't even ride in it comfortably.
Okay, I understand. So the fit isn't right on the jersey. I can definitely help with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. I really needed this to work out. I hope this isn't going to be a problem.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... VF88602. I see the order was delivered 25 days ago. That's no problem at all. For a standard item like a jersey, you're well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So I can send it back for a refund?
Absolutely. We can process a full refund, or if you'd prefer, we can set up an exchange for the next size up. Since you mentioned it was just too tight, perhaps an exchange would be the best option?
You know what, an exchange would be perfect. I'd love to try the larger size. Thank you so much, David. You've really helped me out.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the exchange in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid return label for the original jersey. Just pack it up, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. We'll ship out the new size as soon as the return is scanned. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
